finding.incorrectStatement: Amendment 001 says to preserve an existing link from 紹 to ../kanji/紹.md.
finding.verifiedBaseline: At the published baseline, 紹 in the first paragraph of ## Как сочетаются кандзи is plain text, not a Markdown link. kanji/紹.md is absent from the published baseline.
finding.cause: The candidate mistakenly added a link wrapper around 紹 while adding the authorized reciprocal link for 介; the new wrapper targets a nonexistent page and causes validation to fail.

correction.finalDisposition: Keep 紹 as plain text and add only the authorized [介](../kanji/介.md) wrapper.

qualification: This corrects the source-link availability statement only. It authorizes no new page, runtime path, or word-content change beyond removing the erroneous 紹 link wrapper and retaining the preauthorized 介 link. All 45 direct negative/fallback directions remain UNVERIFIED.
